sector_model: specialty pharmaceuticals with patent cliff: FCF after interest, net debt, EV/FCF, runoff scenario
thesis: Collegium Pharmaceutical (Nasdaq: COLL), specialty pharma with pain (Xtampza ER, Nucynta products, Belbuca) and ADHD (Jornay PM, Azstarys acquired 2026-05-12 for 655.4M cash) products. Q3 2026 net product revenue 216.3M (+3.3%, of which Azstarys 26.5M, so the base business is about -9%); 9M revenue 609.7M (+6.0%), 9M operating income 63.3M vs 118.9M, 9M net income 21.2M helped by an 8.1M tax benefit; Q3 SG&A 99.6M vs 67.1M. TTM revenue 815.2M, net income 38.2M, OCF 338.0M, capex 1.7M, FCF 336.3M after interest, SBC 47.6M. OCF is high because 173.8M of 9M expense is non-cash intangible amortization; working capital added about 16M in 9M. At 24.95 (2026-11-12 close; 52-week 21.43-50.79): market cap about 775M, EV about 1,712M, 20x TTM GAAP earnings, EV/FCF 5.1x, FCF yield 43% (37% after SBC). Debt 1.08B carrying (term loan principal 854.5M, 241.5M 2.875% convertible due 2029) versus cash 144.8M, net debt about 937M. The market is pricing a steep revenue and cash decline, consistent with the Nucynta patent expiry in September 2028 and opioid litigation, not with the current cash flow.
counterthesis: The 43% FCF yield is a TTM figure from a business whose key product patents (Nucynta, amortized through 2028-09-22) end in under two years; generics would remove a large share of cash flow while the 1.1B debt stays, so equity could be worth far less than TTM FCF multiples imply. Base revenue excluding Azstarys fell about 9% in Q3 and SG&A rose 48%. Operating income halved for the 9M. GAAP profit relies on a tax benefit and deferred taxes (cash taxes unread). Opioid exposure: new Pennsylvania payor suit (2026-07-27, removed to federal court 2026-10-19), four state AG investigations, Belbuca paragraph IV challenges (Ascent June 2026, patent to 2032), regulatory and reputational risk to opioid sellers, sole-source suppliers. The ASR and 50M buyback while levered, and working-capital timing of rebates (liability up 109M since year end) could reverse. Product revenue by brand for Xtampza and Nucynta, Q4 guidance, peers (e.g. Pacira, Supernus, Jazz) and the 10-K are unread.
invalidation: The cheap-on-cash case breaks if Nucynta revenue decline starts before 2028, if litigation produces a settlement of material size, or if debt paydown stalls. It strengthens if Azstarys and Jornay growth offsets Nucynta runoff and the term loan is retired faster than guided.
